policy.runtime_merge: Overlay these fields on data/patterns.json by matching pattern_id.

definition.ja: 2色の糸で作るブロークンツイル系のチェックで、先の尖った四方向の形が連続して見える柄です。
definition.en: A two-color broken-twill check whose repeat forms jagged, four-pointed shapes.

ja: 尖った四方向の形が規則的に反復する
通常の格子より輪郭が崩れ、歯や鳥のシルエットのように見える
色よりもギザギザした反復構造で識別する
en: Look for jagged four-pointed units in a regular repeat
The check is visually broken rather than made of plain square cells
Identify it by the pointed repeat, not by a specific colorway

colors.primary_reason: High-contrast editorial recognition reference; black and white are not the only valid colors.

patterns.term_scope: checked cloth / regular two-color check appearance

definition.ja: 白地と有色糸の縦横の帯が同じリズムで交差し、明暗の四角が規則的に並ぶチェックです。
definition.en: A regular check created by crossing colored and white bands, producing repeated light, medium, and darker squares.

ja: 縦横の帯幅が揃い、規則的な四角が並ぶ
交差部が濃く見え、中間色と白地が繰り返される
複雑な太細線よりも均等な反復が目印
en: Equal-width horizontal and vertical bands form regular squares
Intersections read darker than the single-color bands
The even rhythm distinguishes it from more complex plaids

colors.primary_reason: Editorial recognition reference; white plus a colored check is characteristic, but blue is not required.

definition.ja: 複数色の縦横のストライプを一定の順序と幅で反復し、格子状の「sett」を作る織柄です。
definition.en: A woven design in which colored stripes repeat vertically and horizontally in a defined sequence and proportion to form a sett.

ja: 縦と横で同じ色列が交差する
線の色順と幅の比率が個々のタータン識別に関わる
単なる多色チェックよりsettの反復を重視する
en: The same stripe sequence crosses in warp and weft
Color order and stripe proportions matter to a specific tartan sett
The repeated sett distinguishes tartan from a generic multicolor plaid

colors.primary_reason: For a specific tartan, color sequence and stripe proportions are part of its sett; this palette is only an editorial reference.

ja: グレナカートチェック

definition.ja: 細かなチェックやブロークンチェックを組み合わせ、さらに大きな格子として見える複合チェックです。
definition.en: A compound check combining small checks and broken checks so that a larger-scale plaid emerges.

ja: 小さな格子の集合がさらに大きな格子を作る
遠目では灰色調や細かな織柄に見えやすい
単純な千鳥格子より複数スケールの格子がある
en: Small checks combine into a larger-scale check
It often reads as a fine gray or muted texture from a distance
Multiple check scales distinguish it from plain houndstooth

colors.primary_reason: Muted gray/black/white is a useful recognition reference, not a defining rule.

patterns.term_scope: diamond-pattern family used especially in knitwear

definition.ja: 色の異なる菱形を反復し、細い斜線が菱形の上を交差する構成が多い幾何学柄です。
definition.en: A repeating diamond pattern, commonly with thin diagonal lines crossing over the colored lozenges.

ja: 細い対角線が菱形を横切る構成が典型的
単なるダイヤ柄より線の重なりが識別の手掛かり
en: Repeating diamonds or lozenges form the base
Thin diagonal lines commonly cross the diamonds
The overlaid diagonal network helps distinguish argyle from a plain diamond repeat

colors.primary_reason: Argyle uses many palettes; this is only a stable editorial reference.

definition.ja: V字または山形の帯を連続させ、規則的なジグザグを作る幾何学模様です。
definition.en: A geometric repeat built from V-shaped units or bands that create a regular zigzag.

ja: V字が同じ向きと間隔で連続する
山と谷が明瞭なジグザグ線になる
ヘリンボーンのような短い斜線の組み合わせではなく、連続Vを優先して見る
en: Repeated V-shaped units form clear peaks and valleys
The zigzag is continuous and regular
Unlike herringbone, the primary cue is a continuous V rhythm rather than offset short strokes

colors.primary_reason: Geometry rather than color defines the motif.

definition.ja: 同程度の大きさの丸い点を一定の間隔で反復する水玉模様です。
definition.en: A surface pattern of regularly repeated round dots, usually consistent in size and spacing.

ja: 丸い点が多数反復する
点の大きさと間隔に規則性がある
不規則な斑点や動物柄ではなく、人工的な配置が目印
en: Many round dots repeat across the surface
Dot size and spacing are usually regular
The ordered placement distinguishes it from irregular spots or animal markings

colors.primary_reason: Round repeated dots define the pattern; color is variable.

definition.ja: 丸みのある辺と上下の尖りをもつ格子セルなどを反復する、現代のインテリア市場で「Moroccan Trellis」と呼ばれる装飾柄の総称的ラベルです。
definition.en: A contemporary decorative-market label for repeating lattice cells, often with rounded sides and pointed top and bottom.

ja: 同形の格子セルが連続して面を埋める
セルはランタン形・四つ葉形に近い変種を含む
歴史的に単一のモロッコ正典文様と断定せず、市場ラベルとして扱う
en: Repeating lattice cells fill the surface
Common variants resemble lantern or quatrefoil-like cells
Treat the term as a contemporary market label, not as one uniquely canonical historic Moroccan motif

qualification.ja: この名称は現代のインテリア／柄市場で広く使われるラベルとして扱い、単一の歴史的モロッコ正典文様だとは断定しません。
qualification.en: This entry treats the name as a contemporary interiors/pattern-market label and does not claim one uniquely canonical historic Moroccan motif.

colors.primary_reason: No defining historic palette is asserted; this is an editorial reference.

definition.ja: 同心円状の半円弧を扇形に重ね、波が連なって見える日本の伝統文様です。
definition.en: A Japanese traditional motif made from overlapping concentric semicircular arcs arranged like repeating waves.

ja: 半円の中に複数の同心弧がある
半円同士が段違いに重なり波の列を作る
単なる鱗形や円弧ではなく扇状の波の反復が目印
en: Each fan contains several concentric arcs
The fans overlap in staggered rows to read as waves
The layered wave-fan repeat distinguishes it from simple scallops

colors.primary_reason: Indigo/white is an editorial traditional reference; the motif itself is structural.

definition.ja: 正六角形を基礎に放射状の線を組み、麻の葉を思わせる星形が連続する日本の幾何学文様です。
definition.en: A Japanese geometric motif built from regular hexagons and radiating lines, forming star-like units associated with hemp leaves.

ja: 六角形を基礎に細線が中心から放射する
六方向の星形・葉形が連続する
亀甲より内部線が多く、星状の細かな分割が目立つ
en: Regular hexagons provide the underlying grid
Radiating lines create six-point star or leaf-like units
More internal spokes than kikko make the star-like subdivision prominent

ja: 木工・組子風デザイン

colors.primary_reason: Indigo/white is an editorial traditional reference; color does not define the motif.

definition.ja: 同じ大きさの円弧を四分の一ずつ重ね、連続した円形・花形を作る日本の伝統文様です。
definition.en: A Japanese traditional motif formed by overlapping equal circular arcs to create a continuous network of circles and petal-like intersections.

ja: 同じ半径の円が規則的に重なる
交差部に四弁の花のような形が現れる
青海波より完全な円のネットワークとして見える
en: Equal-radius circles overlap in a regular network
It reads as interlocking circles rather than the fan-shaped wave units of seigaiha

colors.primary_reason: Indigo/white is an editorial traditional reference; the circle geometry is defining.

definition.ja: 対照的な色や明度の正方形を交互に並べる、日本で「市松」と呼ばれる格子文様です。
definition.en: The Japanese term for a checker arrangement of alternating square cells in contrasting colors or values.

ja: 同じ大きさの正方形が縦横に並ぶ
隣り合うマスが交互に色・明度を変える
色自体は固定されず、交互配列が本体
en: Equal-size square cells form a grid
Adjacent cells alternate in color or value
The alternating arrangement defines the motif; the colors are not fixed

colors.primary_reason: Black/white is an editorial reference; the alternating-square arrangement is defining.

definition.ja: 正六角形を連続させ、亀の甲羅を思わせる日本の伝統的な幾何学文様です。
definition.en: A Japanese traditional geometric motif based on repeating hexagons associated with tortoiseshell.

ja: 六角形が隙間なく連続する
基本形は内部の放射線を必要としない
麻の葉より単純な六角セルの輪郭が主役
en: Hexagons repeat in a close tessellation
The basic form does not require the internal spokes seen in asanoha
The hexagonal cell outline is the primary cue

colors.primary_reason: Indigo/white is an editorial traditional reference; the hexagonal geometry is defining.

definition.ja: 茎やつるが曲線で連続し、葉や枝を伸ばしながら反復する日本の唐草文様です。
definition.en: A Japanese scrolling-vine motif in which stems and tendrils continue in flowing curves with leaves or offshoots.

ja: 途切れにくい蔓状の曲線が連続する
葉や枝が主線から伸びる
ペイズリーの独立した滴形より、つながる蔓の流れを重視する
en: Continuous vine-like curves travel across the surface
Leaves or branches grow from the main scroll
The connected vine flow distinguishes it from separate paisley boteh units

colors.primary_reason: Green/cream is an editorial traditional reference; the scrolling vine structure is defining.

patterns.term_scope: reversible figured weave / damask-derived ornamental surface pattern

definition.ja: 本来は表裏で地と文様の光沢関係が反転する織物・織組織を指し、現代の表面デザインでは大きな植物・花文様の反復を「ダマスク柄」と呼ぶことがあります。
definition.en: Originally a figured, often reversible weave in which pattern and ground contrast through weave structure; in modern surface design, 'damask pattern' often refers to large repeating floral or foliate motifs derived from that look.

ja: 大きな植物・花・葉のモチーフが反復する表面柄が多い
左右対称に見える構成は一般的だが絶対条件ではない
歴史的な定義はモチーフ形より織組織にある
en: Modern surface versions often repeat large floral or foliate motifs
Symmetry is common but not an absolute defining rule
Historically, damask is defined by weave structure rather than one fixed motif shape

colors.primary_reason: The weave or ornamental structure is defining, not a fixed palette.

patterns.term_scope: scrolling vegetal and geometric ornamental tradition

definition.ja: 植物の茎・葉を抽象化した連続曲線や幾何学的反復を組み合わせる装飾様式・文様群です。
definition.en: An ornamental tradition using rhythmic scrolling vegetal forms, geometric repetition, or combinations of the two.

ja: 曲線的なつる・葉が反復しながら連続する
幾何学的な反復と組み合わさる場合がある
単一の固定モチーフ名ではなく装飾様式の広いカテゴリー
en: Geometric repetition may be combined with foliage
It is a broad ornamental category rather than one single fixed motif

colors.primary_reason: The ornamental structure is defining, not a fixed palette.

definition.ja: 先端が曲がった滴形・葉形の「boteh」を主要モチーフとして反復する装飾柄です。
definition.en: An ornamental repeat built around the boteh, a curved teardrop- or leaf-like motif.

ja: 先端が一方向へ曲がる滴形・葉形が中心
内部に細かな植物・幾何学装飾を持つことが多い
唐草のような連続蔓ではなく、独立したboteh単位が見分けやすい
en: Curved teardrop or leaf-shaped boteh units are the main cue
The motifs often contain smaller floral or geometric decoration
Separate boteh units distinguish paisley from a continuous vine scroll

colors.primary_reason: Boteh structure defines the pattern; no single palette is required.

patterns.term_scope: animal-print imitation of leopard coat markings

definition.ja: ヒョウの被毛に見られる斑紋を模したアニマルプリントで、輪状・ロゼット状の斑点と不規則な点が組み合わさります。
definition.en: An animal print imitating leopard coat markings, using irregular spots and rosette-like ringed markings.

ja: 斑点の位置と大きさが規則正しく揃わない
単純な黒点だけでなく輪状・ロゼット状の斑が混じる
水玉のような等間隔の反復ではない
en: Spot size and placement are irregular
Ringed or rosette-like marks mix with solid spots
It lacks the even spacing and uniform dots of polka dot

colors.primary_reason: Natural leopard coloration supports recognition, though fashion prints may recolor it.

patterns.term_scope: resist-dyeing technique applied to yarn before weaving

definition.ja: 織る前の経糸・緯糸または両方を部分的に防染してから織る技法で、その工程に由来する輪郭のにじみ・ずれがイカットらしい表情を作ります。
definition.en: A resist-dyeing technique in which warp, weft, or both are bound and dyed before weaving; the process often produces softly feathered or shifted motif edges.

ja: モチーフの輪郭にわずかなずれやぼかしが見える
幾何学形や植物形など多様で、形そのものは固定されない
単一の柄名ではなく制作技法として扱う
en: Motif edges often look softly feathered or slightly misregistered
Geometric and floral motifs vary widely; no single shape defines ikat
Treat ikat primarily as a textile technique rather than one fixed pattern

ja: インテリアテキスタイル

qualification.ja: イカットは単一の固定柄ではなく、糸を先に防染してから織る技法です。本辞典では、その技法から生じる視覚的特徴を検索対象にします。
qualification.en: Ikat is not one fixed motif; it is a yarn-resist dyeing technique. This dictionary indexes the visual characteristics produced by that technique.

colors.primary_reason: Indigo/white is an editorial recognition reference; technique, not palette, defines ikat.

patterns.term_scope: flat-woven textile category and kilim-inspired visual family, not one fixed motif

definition.ja: キリムは毛足のない平織り系の敷物・織物カテゴリーで、表面には菱形、フック、帯状幾何学など多様なモチーフが用いられます。本辞典では市場でいう「キリム柄」を、その外観を指す検索ラベルとして扱います。
definition.en: Kilim is a category of pileless flat-woven rugs and textiles that can carry many geometric motifs. Here, 'kilim pattern' is treated as a search label for that visual family rather than one single canonical motif.

ja: 平面的な織物上に幾何学モチーフが反復することが多い
菱形・フック・帯など複数のモチーフ体系を含む
一つの固定柄ではなくキリム外観の検索カテゴリーとして扱う
en: Flat-woven surfaces often carry repeated geometric motifs
Diamonds, hooks, bands, and other motifs vary across kilims
Treat it as a visual search family, not as one fixed canonical pattern

qualification.ja: キリムは単一の固定模様名ではなく、平織り系の敷物・織物カテゴリーです。「キリム柄」はその外観を探すための検索ラベルとして扱います。
qualification.en: Kilim is not one fixed pattern name; it is a category of flat-woven rugs/textiles. 'Kilim pattern' is used here as a practical visual-search label.

colors.primary_reason: Kilim traditions use diverse colors and designs; this fixed palette is only an editorial recognition reference.
